title: LibreLink App 2.4
symptom: User asks if xDrip works with the new LibreLink App 2.4, which Abbott claims is more precise especially for low BGs, and what they need to do.
cause: The new LibreLink app version needs to be patched to work with xDrip, but no one has adopted the patches to the new version. The extraction method may not change precision between old and new versions.
evidence_quote: The problem is, that the new app needs to be patched, but this is hardly liunked to a specific version of LibreLink.
